description: Anionic E2 elimination sample with separated product-like endpoint geometry.
notes: Atom 7 is the beta hydrogen transferred to hydroxide in the product geometry.
This is an intentionally simple anionic elimination test and may need endpoint optimization before production use.
The closely related F- + C2H5Cl SN2/E2 competition has literature data, but this hydroxide/chloride sample has no curated value in this patch.
The formal charge is included in the sample name suffix and repeated in this JSON for UI validation.
